'''Star Wars CCG''' (also ''Star Wars'' Customizable Card Game, SWCCG / SW:CCG) is the customizable card game published by [[Decipher|Decipher, Inc.]] from December 1995 through 2001.<ref name="wp">[https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Star_Wars_Customizable_Card_Game Star Wars Customizable Card Game], Wikipedia</ref>

The game is based on the ''Star Wars'' franchise. After Decipher lost the license, volunteer [[Players Committee]] support continued organized play and later virtual cards; see [[History of the Players Committee]].

== Creators ==

Wikipedia credits the game's designers as [[Tom Braunlich]], [[Rollie Tesh]], [[Warren Holland]], and [[Jerry Darcy]].<ref name="wp" /> Overview, sourcing notes, and gaps: [[Creators of SWCCG]].

An older CardGuide-derived stub on this wiki once listed different names (including Chuck Kallenbach). That listing is '''not''' followed here; see the conflict note on [[Creators of SWCCG]].

== Expansions ==

See the Decipher expansion tiles on the [[Main Page]], beginning with [[Premiere Limited]] (December 1995).
